messages:
alina: Quick design question: should the canary legend be collapsible? Users on small screens say it crowds the timeline.

jon: Collapsible makes sense. If collapsed, show an icon-only legend with accessible name. Expand on hover/focus.

miriam: A11y: icon-only legend must have aria-label and be reachable by keyboard. When expanded, announce the legend items with aria-live=\"polite\".

sam: Also: confirmation flow for revert needs more context. Instead of just "Are you sure?" show commit, author, time, and a small checkbox "I understand this will change traffic". That helps auditability.

alina: Good. For tiny screens collapse by default and show a small "legend" button that opens a tray. Keep the primary actions out of the tray.

miriam: Final checklist: 1) collapsible legend with aria-label, 2) polite aria-live for expansion, 3) keyboard focus for legend toggle, 4) rich confirm dialog with commit details + confirmation checkbox.

jon: I'll add CSS for responsive collapse and hand off to dev.

alina: Thanks all, I'll update the figma and add notes.
